name: Idealization
source:
After deciding to go on a walk early one morning to calm down after a nightmare, your life can change for the better or the worse. Deciding to save his life could very well ruin yours. Like everything in life though, you have choices! Let's hope you make the right ones. Just a warning though, Everyone. And I mean EVERYONE. Has choices that could get them killed.

[From [url=https://officalantitherapist.itch.io/idealization]Itch.io[/url]]
